instruction:
Using public GitHub pages in nodejs/node and the GitHub repository documentation it links to, report the latest stable Node.js release tag and publication date, the release lines currently identified as Active LTS and Maintenance, the
    documented security-reporting channel, the kinds of versions covered by the security policy, and the exact paths of the files supplying those facts. Stopping condition: stop after the release, lifecycle, and security information have all been cross-
    checked. Constraints: do not sign in; exclude prereleases; do not submit a vulnerability report; do not use non-GitHub search snippets as evidence.
